review.algorithm_assessment: All chords have the same shorter circular length. An earlier chord crosses the new chord exactly when one endpoint is strictly inside its short arc; no equal-length chord has both endpoints strictly inside. Fenwick counts endpoints with multiplicity and excludes shared endpoints. Each crossing plus1 adds a region; reverse orientation for k>n/2 is a reflection.
